title: Small-Hom supported category carrying a given compact detector
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] in universe $u$ and $V\subseteq Y$ open. Let $E,Q\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category] have cohomology stalks zero on $V$. Assume the ambient property of quasi-coherent cohomology and zero stalks on $V$ is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category], $E$ is compact [def-pc-compact-object] for universe-$u$ coproducts [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], and every supported $K$ is zero precisely when $\operatorname{Hom}(E[n],K)=0$ for all integers $n$. There exists a category $C$ with objects in universe $u+1$ and Hom sets in universe $u$, with a triangulated structure and universe-$u$ coproducts, and an additive exact functor $F:C\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ preserving these coproducts, whose image has quasi-coherent cohomology. There exist $e,q\in C$ with $F(e)\cong E$, $F(q)\cong Q$, such that $e$ is compact and the singleton family $e$ generates $C$ [def-pc-generators]. No tower or telescope is asserted.

proof.text: Let P be the ambient property of quasi-coherent complexes with zero cohomology stalks on V. The supplied triangulated hypothesis equips its full subcategory with the inherited triangulated structure. E and Q lie in it by their supplied support properties.

proof.text: The proved private helper supported_closed_coproducts first uses schemeDerivedQCohClosedUnderCoproducts for quasi-coherence. For stalk vanishing, choose complex representatives using the localization functor object-preimage operation. Apply derivedAmbientDirectSums to identify each homology sheaf of their derived coproduct with the coproduct of the input homology sheaves, and transport to the supplied colimit presentation. Applying the stalk functor transports that isomorphism. exists_stalk_directSum_linearEquiv identifies the stalk of the sheaf sum with the direct sum of the input stalks. Each input is subsingleton by the support hypotheses, so that direct sum and hence the output stalk are subsingleton. This applies also to the empty family. The full-subcategory inclusion creates coproducts; derivedAmbientHasCoproducts supplies the ambient coproducts.

proof.text: Install the proved source-library SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian instance on the shared sheaf-of-modules carrier, then Abelian.hasKInjectiveResolutions_of_isGrothendieckAbelian. Apply the proved DerivedCategory.locallySmall instance from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.GrothendieckAbelian.HasDerivedCategory. Faithfulness of the supported full-subcategory inclusion gives LocallySmall at universe u. This does not need the ringed-site theorem with its extra generator and functorial-resolution conclusions.

Take C = ShrinkHoms of the supported full subcategory and its canonical equivalence. triangulatedEquivalenceTransfer gives the zero object, preadditive structure, shifts, additive shifts and triangulated structures, together with exactness of the equivalence functor and inverse. Equivalence adjunction transports coproduct existence. Let F be the inverse followed by the ambient inclusion; inferred composition instances give its shift compatibility, exactness, additivity and preservation of coproducts. The quasi-coherent image property is the first component of the supported object property. The two specified objects give e and q with reflexive image isomorphisms.

proof.text: Factor the supported inclusion through D_QCoh(Y). It is fully faithful and additive, and preserves coproducts because its composite with the fully faithful D_QCoh inclusion preserves them and that inclusion reflects them. The proved private helper compact_of_fully_faithful compares the two Hom direct-sum maps using additive Hom equivalences and sigmaComparison; equality is checked on each summand, and bijectivity transfers. Thus hcompact proves compactness of e. The proved private helper singleton_generator_of_detection uses hgen: a nonzero model object has nonzero image since F is faithful and additive, hence receives a nonzero map from E[n]. The shift-equivalence adjunction transports this to E -> F(K)[-n], preserving zero. The image isomorphism of e and the shift comparison produce a nonzero map F(e) -> F(K[-n]); fullness lifts it to the model, and preservation of zero proves its nonvanishing. Precompose with the unique-index coproduct isomorphism to obtain the required generator map.

lean.statement: theorem supported_compact_detector_model (Y : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (V : Y.Opens) (E Q : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (htri : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : schemeDerivedCategory Y ↦ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K ∧ ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K).val.presheaf y)))) (hcompact : letI : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y IsCompactObject E) (hsupport : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj E.obj).val.presheaf y))) (hgen : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y, (∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K.obj).val.presheaf y))) → (IsZero K.obj ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj))) (hQ : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj Q.obj).val.presheaf y))) : ∃ (C : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Category.{u} C) (_ : HasZeroObject C) (_ : HasShift C ℤ) (_ : Preadditive C) (_ : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive) (_ : Pretriangulated C) (_ : IsTriangulated C) (_ : HasCoproducts.{u} C) (F : C ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (_ : F.CommShift ℤ), F.IsTriangulated ∧ F.Additive ∧ (∀ I : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F) ∧ (∀ K : C, schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (F.obj K)) ∧ ∃ e q : C, Nonempty (F.obj e ≅ E.obj) ∧ Nonempty (F.obj q ≅ Q.obj) ∧ IsCompactObject e ∧ IsTriangulatedGeneratingFamily (fun _ : ULift.{u} Unit ↦ e)
